{{Quote|How much for a run to Tassar?|Cassian Andor, to Xanwan|<ref name="TWBM">{{Andor|That Would Be Me}}</ref>}}
'''Tassar''' was a location<ref name="TWBM" /> in the [[D'Astan sector]]'s [[Tassar system]], which was situated in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix" /> amd the [[New Territories]].<ref name="NewTerritories" /> It was situated in grid square P-5 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Appendix" />

When the [[human]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] was hoping to leave<ref name="TWBM" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Blevin">{{Databank|supervisor-blevin|Supervisor Blevin}}</ref> [[Ferrix]]<ref name="TWBM" /> in [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|102}}</ref> he inquired about passage to Tassar at [[Xanwan's freight kiosk]], a transport business in [[Ferrix City]]. The proprietor [[Xanwan]] asked Andor several questions about his trip, and when he requested both immediacy and discretion, Xanwan said it would [[Currency|cost]] him 900. Andor scoffed at the number, and the two eventually settled on 700, with Xanwan stating Andor had better be ready to go in one [[Standard hour|hour]].<ref name="TWBM" /> Andor ultimately left Ferrix with the [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Luthen Rael]] instead.<ref name="Reckoning">{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tassar was mentioned in "[[That Would Be Me]],"<ref name="TWBM" /> the second episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], which was released on [[September 21]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}}</ref> In the accompanying episode guide released on [[StarWars.com]], Tassar was incorrectly spelled as "Tasser."<ref name="Story Gallery">{{SW|url=andor-s1-e2-story-gallery|text="That Would Be Me" Story Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 9}}</ref>
